cause.classification: model-setting difference (GMAT density without anomalous oxygen)
cause.statement: GMAT gtd7 excludes anomalous oxygen; FFM and Orekit use gtd7d drag-effective density. The day-mean density ratio times the independently stored drag effect accounts for the meter-scale gap. A constant Cd multiplier is an approximation to the varying density ratio: the corrected trajectory is the measured residual, not a claim of exact model identity.
cause.residualInterpretation: The measured corrected residual meets both the 1.5 m GMAT limit and the 0.1 m shared default.

protocol.source: Pinned NASA GMAT trajectories and the shared ffm-reference-cases.json protocol; FFM scores refreshed from the shipped WASM using C++ reductions.
protocol.units: maximum 3D position difference, meters; STM relative column difference, dimensionless
protocol.frame: GCRF; EME2000 for explicitly marked EME2000 cases
protocol.toleranceRationale: Unchanged shared GMAT protocol: point mass 0.01 m, gravity 0.05 m, SRP 0.1 m, drag 1.5 m. Corrected drag also compared with the shared default 0.1 m. The JR atmosphere frame note is retained verbatim.
protocol.replayToleranceRationale: Exact replay of the same shipped WASM, inputs and settings. C++ disables fused multiply-add so kilometer-to-meter conversion rounds before subtraction as in the historical scorer; the C++ norm reproduces both stored scores exactly. worstM, atHour and integration steps must all match exactly.

verdict.statement: 51 of 57 cases meet the stated GMAT limits at the suite setting. All six misses are NRLMSISE-00 drag cases at all three FFM settings; each records the anomalous-oxygen density convention and measured Cd-scaled residual. The misses remain met:false at 1.5 m.
